lines.text: On the thirteenth of Adar, the Jews overpowered those who hated them, and no man could withstand them.
The provincial officials helped the Jews because the fear of Esther had fallen upon them.
In the citadel of Susa the Jews killed five hundred men, including Haman's ten sons, but took no plunder.
At Esther's request the king ordered it, and on the fourteenth the Jews in Susa killed seven hundred more men.
In the provinces the Jews killed 75,000 enemies, then rested on the fourteenth with feasting, joy and gifts.
